arguments.subject: Re: Open house catering, final headcount
arguments.body:
Hi Joy,

The confirmed yes count I can verify so far is 11 people, including guests: Lucia + Sam (2), Jonas (1), Priya + two colleagues (3), Ben (1), Tomas (1), and Greta + one (2). I have not counted the no replies or Noor's maybe.

This is based on the 10 most recent messages available to me; the mailbox indicates 7 older matching messages were not loaded, so I can't confirm that 11 is the complete final headcount.

Best,
Ori

item.text:
I can verify **11 yeses, including guests**: Lucia and Sam (2), Jonas (1), Priya and two colleagues (3), Ben (1), Tomas (1), and Greta plus one (2). I didn’t count the no replies or Noor’s “maybe.”

I emailed Joy at Saltwater Kitchen that count, noting it may not be complete: the mailbox showed 7 older matching messages that weren’t loaded, so I couldn’t confirm whether they affect the total. Joy’s address accepted the email.
